# Section 1: Overview

## Purpose
The purpose of this document is to bring reliability in the UI specifically with Advance Export incentive handling.

## Business Requirement
Certainly, in order to make the UI more interactive and efficient with regards to Advance Export Incentive handling.

## Scope
The Scope of these specs is to enhance the below screens:-
• Sales invoice
• Export Incentive
• Duty Script movement

# Section 2. Assumptions
• No Assumptions

# Section 3. Prerequisite Master Configuration – Government Based Incentive

## Section 1: Configuration of Government Based Incentive
WFX provides a feature to configure government-based export incentives such as DBK (Duty Drawback) and RoSCTL (Rebate of State and Central Taxes and Levies) & RoDTEP (Remission of Duties and Taxes on Export Products) within the Incentive Master module.
Proposed Navigation for Incentive Configuration: Finance >> Master Definition >> AR Master >> Incentive Configuration
Incentive Master is divided into three sections:
• DBK Master
• RoSCTL Master
• RoDTEP Master
DBK Master, RoSCTL & RoDTEP:
Upon selecting the DBK, RoSCTL & RoDTEP from Incentive master, a configuration screen will open where DBK related Incentives can be set up.
UI Correction:
Segment field will be a text field.
RoDTEP Column names: RoDTEP No. , BEGIN DATE, EXPIRY DATE, CENTRAL RATE %, CENTRAL CAP, STATE RATE%, STATE CAP, Description.
DBK Column names: DBK No., BEGIN DATE, EXPIRY DATE, DBK RATE %, DBK CAP VALUE, SEGMENT, DESCRIPTION, UOM.
RoSCTL Column names : RoSCTL No., BEGIN DATE, EXPIRY DATE, CENTRAL RATE %, CENTRAL CAP, STATE RATE%, STATE CAP, Description
RoDTEP: Upon selecting the RodTEP from Incentive Master, a configuration screen will open where RodTEP related incentive values can be set up. User can maintain RodTEP No., Begin Date, Expiry Date, Central Rate %, Central Cap, State Rate % and State Cap. Begin Date and Expiry Date will be validated at the time of ASN or Shipping Bill, and based on the applicable date, RodTEP values will be calculated.
UOM – Will come from UOM master.
When the user gets an additional line of incentive with same no. As previous incentive no. Then the expiry date of Previous incentive no. Will freeze. And for new line the Begin date will be added and again expiry date for new line with same incentive no. Will be left blank.
Import: Will only be used for New Entry (Just like Insert command).
For Example:

#### Attributes Change
Revision of other attributes can be done using manual data, but it will be possible only with change of Expiry date.
System will not allow same date as “Begin Date” and “Expiry On” date.
Significance of Log (Activity Timeline) Button:
A Log button is available on DBK, RoSCTL & RoDTEP Master screens. This button allows users to view the history of all changes made in the respective masters, including what was changed, who made the changes, and when they were made. It helps track updates and maintain transparency in the system.
Significance of Import/Export Button:
UI Correction: Inside Header level Context menu, we don't need Delete Button functionality.
An Import and Export button is provided in the DBK Master RoSCTL & RoDTEP Master screens. The Export button allows users to download the existing data in Excel format, make necessary changes offline, and use the Import button to upload the updated file back into the system. This feature is useful for bulk data updates and saves time compared to manual entry.
The same validations will be applicable in RoSCTL & RoDTEP.
NOTE:
• Only those DBK entries marked as Active & Non - Expired in the DBK Master will be available for selection during Article Master configuration.
• In Case if there is any Updation recorded against serial number by govt , then user should have option to add New line in DBK and Rosctl & RoDTEP master and exiting line should be marked as non-editable with One day prior date as end date to New Begin date.
• The date should not be bound with the respective calendar and financial year.
• Only Active RoSCTL & RoDTEP entries in the RoSCTL & RoDTEP Master will come while configuring the Article Master.

## Section 2: Selection of Government Based Incentive
In this screen, DBK have dropdown and RoSCTL will come according to the DBK and it Is non editable, and the data in these dropdowns comes from the respective master forms discussed earlier. Only the fields marked as Active in the masters are displayed in the dropdowns.
Uder RoSCTL we need RoDTEP as Dropdown field.
The highlighted Columns will be enabled/disabled from SLC and this will be applicable for all categories.
Significance of Scheme Field:
Scheme Dropdown – 1. Import
2. Export
3. Domestic
The Scheme field contains options: Import, Export and Domestic. These options are directly linked to the visibility and selection of DBK and RoSCTL & RoDTEP.
In this screen, only those DBK, RoSCTL & RoDTEP entries are visible which have Domestic selected in the Fabric Type field.
But system should validate that RoSCTL have same value which we have selected in DBK Master
NOTE: In DBK and RoSCTL Field Serial No. and Description will come together.

### Change of DBK and RoSCTL on techpack.
Once selected by user, the system will keep a local copy of DBK and RoSCTL Serial no.
In case of an update on existing Serial Number where techpack is having an old record “Begin Date”, the system will show old record information on the hover.
Sales ASN
In case of sales ASN, DBK, RoSCTL & RoDTEP will be visible in tab Style details where system will auto populate DBK and RoSCTL number based on value selected in Style Master.
Sales ASN will carry the serial no. information from Style/article, Same Serial no. Will auto – populate on Shipping bill and incentive rate will resolve based on shipping bill date and Begin and Expiry date will be validated based on applicable date (ASN Created on Date) drawbacks or RoSCTL values will be calculated.
There is a change in the Style Detail tab where the system will show DBK and RoSTCL Serial no. on the Style, Color & Size (SKU) Level. If needed, the user will be able to change this data.
UI Correction: Need a column name as RoDTEP with DBK and RoSCTL.
Selection of DBK & RoSCTL & RoDTEP will be used to calculation provisional incentives.

# Section 4. Functional Requirement Description – Export Logistics Management
Screen 02– Shipment Plan

## Shipment Plan New
Navigation- Sales>>ASN>>Shipment plan>>New

### Header Section
Fields (Dropdowns)
The following dropdown fields will be available:
• Shipment Plan For
• Type: Dropdown (Mandatory) – Article/ kitpack
• Values: Configurable (same as ASN screen)
• Buyer
• Type: Dropdown (Mandatory)
• Source: Buyer master data
• Destination
• Type: Dropdown
• Source: Predefined destination list / country master
• If destination is selected before selection of orders, then orders will be filtered based on selected destination.
• If destination is not selected, then all the outstanding orders will appear for the selected customer. This would be an optional field and can be selected after selection of orders.
• Shipment Plan No.: System Generated (We need a company name/company division/financial year /location and site code fields in system coding)
• Location: Mandatory field
This will be a dropdown field fetched from the master data (Division addresses). Only Shipping and Billing addresses will come.
• Site: Mandatory field
This will be a dropdown field fetched from the master data. It will be filtered based on selected locations (My company Addresses).
• Shipment Plan Date: Mandatory Field
Manual and it should not be selected in previous date.

• Delete
• Deletes selected row(s) from grid
• Multi-select supported

### Editable Fields
Shipment Plan Qty
• Type: Numeric Input
• Mandatory: Yes (should allow 0 value also)
• Validation:
• Shipping qty should not exceed order quantities + applicable tolerance.
• For any order / OC line, system should check already planned quantity + current entered planned quantity against available balance quantity including buyer tolerance. Eg- If order quantity is 100 pcs and buyer tolerance is 5%, then maximum allowed shipment planning is 105 pcs. Now suppose already shipment plans are created for 70 pcs. Then while creating/revising another shipment plan, user should not be allowed to enter more than 35 pcs.
Formula: Already Planned Qty + Current Input Shipment Qty ≤ Order Qty + Applicable Tolerance Qty or Current Input Shipment Qty ≤ Balance Qty including Tolerance

## SLC Configuration:
• Logic info tab will be configured via screen layout configurator.
• Logistic info tab should be flexible to add extra fields/ flexi fields (from existing flexi field masters available under FA module). Will have to add transaction type on the shipment plan.

### Grid Level Features:
Each row in the Shipment Plan grid will have:
• A row-level checkbox for individual selection.
• A context menu with the following options:
• Activity Timeline
• Revise
Behaviour:
• Actions here are specific to the selected row only.
• “Revise” will follow business rules (e.g. Before tax invoice).
• Create PSN – Create PSN and Progress Column Updated as PSN Created.
• Create ASN – Creates ASN and Progress Column updated as ASN Created.
• Create tax invoice- Create tax invoice and progress column updated as tax invoice created.
• Create E-Invoice- Create E-Invoice and progress column updated as per E-Invoice Created.
• Sales Invoice – Progress column updated as Sent to FA.

• Input field / dropdown filter
• Filter icon for advanced filtering
• Users can filter data column-wise independently (e.g., Buyer, Status, GDN No., etc.)
• Filters will work in combination (multi-column filtering supported).

### Status
The Status column in the Shipment Plan List will represent the current stage of the shipment plan based on system transactions and document creation. The statuses are defined as follows:
• Saved: Indicates that the shipment plan is in draft state and has been saved but not yet confirmed.
• Confirmed: Indicates that the shipment plan has been finalized and the transaction is confirmed.
• Closed: Indicates that the ASN (Advanced Shipment Notice) has been successfully created against the shipment plan.
• Booked: Indicates that the PSN Invoice has been generated for the shipment plan, confirming booking completion.
Shipment plan can only be revised before the confirmation of sales ASN. In case PSN (Confirmed) and ASN (Saved) are created and user revises the shipment plan then these documents will start appearing in day-sync status (with red color) and these document statuses will have tool sync with shipment plan. If these documents are not in sync, then system will not allow user to confirm the sales ASN. If PSN and ASN are created against shipment plan then qty information will be coming from shipment plan with non-editable mode.

## PSN:
• PSN will have one more option of “PSN against” (configured from screen layout). It will have only one option “Shipment plan”. All the header and grid information will auto-populate date from shipment plan (Fields available in shipment plan).
• Pop-up Fields- If PSN is created against shipment plan, then below fields will be available in pop-up (only confirmed shipment plans will be available).
Shipment plan no
Date
Sales contract no
Buyer

## PSN list
PSN list will have one more column “Shipment plan no”. This will also be configurable from system. It will have one more tool to sync shipment planned qty.

## ASN:
A new option “Shipment Plan” will be added in the “ASN Against” dropdown on the ASN creation screen.
This option will be applicable when:
• ASN Type = With GDN/ without GDN
• ASN is created for Article/Kit
When the user selects:
• ASN Type → With GDN/ without GDN
• ASN Against → Shipment Plan
The ASN will be created based on the selected Shipment Plan No.
Pop-up fields:
Shipment plan no
Date
Sales contract no
Buyer
Screenshot For your Reference Only will not impact Current screen of sales ASN.

## ASN list
ASN list will have one more column “Shipment plan no, Tax Invoice no. & Tax Invoice Date”. This will also be configurable from system. It will have one more tool to sync shipment planned qty.
It will have Two more extra tools to generate and regenerate tax invoice number. Generate tool will only work for confirmed sales ASN. If user clicks on regenerate tax invoice tool then system will cancel the existing sales ASN and create a new ASN in draft mode automatically with same information as previous.

## Shipment Sequence Configurator:
UI Correction: FA → Master Definition → Account Receivables → Sequence Configurator
Path
FA → Master Definition → Account Receivables → Shipment Sequence Configurator
Purpose
The purpose of the Shipment Sequence Configurator is to define and control the sequence flow of shipment-related transactions within the system. This configuration helps users understand and manage how shipment transactions progress from Sales Order creation until Sales Invoice generation.
The configurator (Will work member company wise) ensures that transactions are created in the correct sequence as per business requirements and prevents users from skipping mandatory transaction stages.
Different flows can be configured under the Flow setup configurator.
Flow Type will be of two types only - Local & Export.
Under configure, user can define the flow of the transactions as per the flow rules mentioned below:
Row 1:
Value: Sales Order Only
Type: Static (non-editable)
Row 2:
Dropdown Options:
Shipment Plan
ASN
PSN
Buyer Order Dispatch
Row 3 (Depends on Row 2):
If row 2 selection is Shipment plan then ASN and PSN will appear in row 3 dropdown.
If row 2 selection is ASN then Buyer order dispatch and tax invoice will appear in row 3 dropdown.
If row 2 selection is PSN then ASN and Buyer order dispatch will appear in row 3 dropdown.
If row 2 selection is Buyer order dispatch then row 3 and row 4 will be unselectable and the flow will directly jump to row 5.
Row 4 (Depends on Row 3):
If row 2 selection is Shipment plan and row 3 selection is ASN then PSN and buyer order dispatch will appear in row 4 dropdown.
If row 2 selection is Shipment plan and row 3 selection is PSN then buyer order dispatch and tax invoice will appear in row 4 dropdown.
If row 2 selection is ASN, PSN or buyer order dispact and row 3 selection is any of the available options then row 4 will be disabled.
Row 5
Will show the option to select tax invoice or buyer order dispatch.
Row 6
Will show the option to select tax invoice or E-Invoice.
Row 7
Will show the option to select sales invoice.
Information (i) Button Functionality
The system shall provide an Information (i) button in the Shipment Sequence Configurator screen as shown in Image.
On Clicking the Information (i) Button:
• The system shall display the transaction flow for all configured cases.
• The flow visualization shall help users understand the sequence of transactions for each shipment flow case.
These cases will not be hard coded, there should be some flexibility to define these cases on the UI.
Note: if nothing is defined then user have to define the sequence.

UI For Reference:
https://stitch.withgoogle.com/preview/10500034027548083751?node-id=8675dd8eaea344abaf8ecbb4e7edbec5
User Story:

## Meeting Points:
Buyer orders will be created in WFX
Shipment Plan will be created in WFX consisting of Sales Order Lines where shipment is due/ planned.
Shipment plan will be created on Customer PO (WFX delivery OC) level
Multiple OCs can be clubbed under one shipment plan
Pre-Shipment Sales Invoice (PSN) will be created based on shipment Plan created in previous stage.
Shipment plan list screen will have multiple status update will be provided (PSN created, ASN Created, Sent to FA, etc.)

## Solution=> Shipment Plan
Shipment plan will be created by selecting multiple delivery OCs as per user requirement:

## Shahi Business Requirements
The sales/ Production team will create a shipment plan that can include multiple deliveries and multiple destinations, grouped under a primary destination which will auto-populate in the Pre-Shipment Export Invoice/ Sales ASN but can be modified by the logistics team during ASN creation, where only a single destination will be selected. Multiple ASNs can be created under a single shipment plan. The shipment plan remains editable by the factory until the ASN is in the creation stage; however, once the Pre-Booking is done and ASN is completed, the shipment plan becomes locked. If any changes are made to the shipment plan, the system will trigger an email alert to the respective authorized personnel, which will act as an approval mechanism for revising either the shipment plan, PSN or the ASN. Upon such changes, the PSN/ ASN quantity will be updated based on the shipment plan (for example, reducing order quantity from 100 to 80). In the Sales ASN confirmed mode, a checkbox labeled “Applied for Booking” will be introduced; once selected, neither the shipment plan, PSN or ASN can be revised. This checkbox can only be unchecked by an authorized user based on existing permission controls, after which revisions to both ASN and shipment plan will be allowed. Additionally, once the shipment is confirmed and an e-way bill is generated, the ASN can be recreated only by cancelling the tax invoice and generating a new ASN with the existing data but a new ASN number, specifically in cases where shipment execution fails or requires correction. The shipment plan will also include a shipment tolerance percentage driven from the Buyer Master, which can vary across different Shahi divisions.
**During plan user can take multiple destinations but will have one destination as group. Same will be auto populate in Sales ASN However it can be changed as per requirement.

- definition (§ Section 4. Functional Requirement Description – Export Logistics Management › Shahi Business Requirements): If any changes are made to the shipment plan, the system will trigger an email alert to the respective authorized personnel, which will act as an approval mechanism for revising either the shipment plan, PSN or the ASN.
